I have farmed here in Ruvuma for many years, and I know this small plot near the house grows good maize if I give it some attention. I will put a little of the subsidized fertilizer and some cow manure on it because the soil benefits from both, and I will plant the improved seed I was able to get from the extension agent last season. Since the rains here in the Southern Highlands are usually reliable, I do not need to irrigate, and my family and I will clear the weeds by hand with our hoes rather than buying expensive sprays.
